introduction: Texas 2-1-1 connects residents with community services. A referral helps identify a provider; it does not approve benefits.
description: Texas 2-1-1 connects residents with community services. A referral helps identify a provider; it does not approve benefits.

sections.who: Anyone seeking information can use the free, anonymous service.
sections.get: County-appropriate referrals for food, housing, utility and other needs.
sections.docs:
• Your city or county.
  • A description of the need and urgency.
sections.apply:
1. Contact the network

    Call 211 or 877-541-7905, or search the directory.

  2. Explain your situation

    Ask which provider serves your location and whether you need an appointment.

  3. Contact the provider

    Confirm its own application requirements.
sections.after: Save the referral and contact the provider directly about availability.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Texas 211 service. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: The network describes availability around the clock, every day.
No. The organization receiving the referral makes its own decision.
The network describes its service as anonymous.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
